gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_details d ON d.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT (SELECT sum(rev) FROM (SELECT rev FROM r ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5) t) / (SELECT sum(rev) FROM r)

    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
    (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / 
     (SELECT SUM(od2.unit_price * od2.quantity * (1 - od2.discount)) 
      FROM order_details od2 
      JOIN orders o2 ON od2.order_id = o2.order_id)) * 100 AS share_of_total_revenue
FROM 
    order_details od
JOIN 
    orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    c.customer_id IN (
        SELECT customer_id 
        FROM (
            SELECT customer_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS revenue
            FROM order_details od3
            JOIN orders o3 ON od3.order_id = o3.order_id
            GROUP BY customer_id
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) AS top_customers
    )
